snippet.title: Wind Chill - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
In Wind Chill, you work as a Search & Rescue officer, and you must keep yourself sane and log objects you find in the woods, all while facing off against twisted creatures. With a flashlight as your only pair of eyes, you have until 6AM to find your subjects. Good luck.

Play the DEMO on Steam now! - https://store.steampowered.com/app/3827240/Wind_Chill/
